crossRefs.note: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes…

translations.web: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
translations.bsb: When it snows, she has no fear for her household, for they are all clothed in scarlet.
translations.kjv: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
translations.asv: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; For all her household are clothed with scarlet.
